name: Sorcerer and Demon: Comfort
source:
Daniel had a rough day - went out with his family that doesn't know he's trans. Fortunately, this time he's not coming back to an empty apartment and Dantalion is more than willing to make him forget all about this experience.

[from [url=https://animefanka.itch.io/sorcerer-and-demon-comfort]itch.io[/url]]
